thread:
cassie_cs: heads-up — kickoff for Frontier Labs dedicated pool bring-up. slot starts Mon 2024-08-12 18:00 UTC. primary asks: quota numbers, autoscale policy, loadtest window, KMS handoff. quick summary below.

em_am: got it — I'll confirm budget/renewal redlines. Frontier security wants KMS key and proof of no egress to public buckets. KMS id: frontier-kms.

cassie_cs: thanks. target capacity requested by the customer: steady 600 qps, burst 3k qps for 5m, sustained peak windows 10m. want to prime KV cache and prefix warm caches.

tyler_eng: quick question — which model/seq-length profile are we serving for the heavy tail? 

cassie_cs: primary model is rw-medium-8k (2 variants: fp16 and int8 fast). typical prompt median ~120 tokens, 95th ~900. planning quantized variant as fallback for cost.

nora_sre: for autoscaler I suggest: target node util 70%, scale-up at 75% sustained 2m, scale-down at 30% sustained 5m, max nodes = reserved pool size (set by quota). p95 latency SLO target 250ms. set downscale cooldown = 5m to avoid thrash.

tyler_eng: noted. do we want slow-roll canary during cutover? one AZ at a time?

em_am: Frontier prefers single-region first (us-west-2), canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. ops will watch errors.

jae_devex: prepping loadgen configs. sharing a minimal `redwood-loadgen` snippet for our internal run:

```
# redwood-loadgen snippet
concurrency: 120
rps_profile:
  - ramp: {from: 50, to: 600, duration: 10m}
  - spike: {to: 3000, duration: 5m}
prompt_template: "<system>...
user: {{sample_prompt}}"
request_timeouts: {connect: 5s, read: 30s}
headers: {Authorization: "Bearer $LOADGEN_TOKEN"}
```

jae_devex: run this from the staging harness in our sandbox account, then replay traffic via shadowing to dedicated pool.

cassie_cs: schedule proposal: 
- Fri 2024-08-09 16:00 UTC: security handoff + KMS key proof (EM)
- Sun 2024-08-11 02:00 UTC: reserved pool provisioning (infra)
- Mon 2024-08-12 18:00 UTC: warmup + priming scripts (dev owns)
- Mon 2024-08-12 21:00 UTC: progressive loadtests and canary traffic

tyler_eng: I'll own the warmup script and kv-prefix priming. will post script + run notes by EOD Thu.

nora_sre: I'll own autoscaler tuning during the first 4 hours of loadtests and the tracing hooks. please ensure x-request-id is propagated so we can trace p95 spikes.

cassie_cs: important checklist items: 
- quota stamp in billing (em)
- KMS IAM cross-account roles verified (em + infra)
- runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/frontier-dedicated-warmup (public internal doc)
- fallback model config for cost fallback (tyler)

deploy-bot: reserved-pool frontier-prod-6155 created by infra-svc — pool id rp-0a3f2b (auto).

em_am: billing commit is in — confirmed monthly reserved capacity charge. I filed the renewal flag in the account (risk: standard).

tyler_eng: posted warmup script gist: https://gist.internal/tyler/frontier-warmup (contains curl + batch priming loop). snippet: `for key in $(seq 1 5000); do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d @payload.json; done`

cassie_cs: can everyone react with :thumbsup: once they have the checklist item marked? also if anyone needs a different time for the main loadtest, speak now.

nora_sre: :thumbsup: i'll have tracing on and alert thresholds muted for the normal spike window to avoid noise.

jae_devex: :thumbsup: loadgen harness will write metrics to /tmp/frontier-load-2024-08-12 for postmortem.

em_am: :thumbsup: I looped in Frontier Ops that they should expect a controlled canary and not to toggle traffic until final signoff.

cassie_cs: perfect — final note: capture any customer feedback during warmup in the onboarding ticket (CS-3421). we'll run a short retro after the cutover.

tyler_eng: all set from eng side. will push warmup script and run a dry run Sat 08:00 UTC.

cassie_cs: thanks team — closing initial thread. will reopen if blockers show up.
